rules: Do not tune or change frozen weights, routing, horizons or model parameters after importing new outcomes.
Preserve July 28 UTC origin and source-pool identities. New unknown hardware/pools remain explicit persistence fallback.
Use identical observations, price units, origins and targets; purge six-hour boundary crossings.
Report CPU and GPU independently, Stockholm and new regional cohorts separately, plus all horizons/regions/pool losses.
Use chronological time blocks rather than treating overlapping forecasts as iid samples.
Do not deploy a policy that regresses Stockholm aggregate MAE for a resource merely because another region improves.
No stop-when-winning or automatic promotion; report the full fixed interval even if results are unfavorable.
limitations: New-region October dates are unscored regional outcomes but contemporaneous Stockholm dates were previously examined; disclose this dependence.
Requires new prepared data/import and a forward-scoring run. This file is a protocol, not a completed result or a scheduled collection.
A public archive may not yet be published; no account upgrade or paid cloud provisioning is authorized or required.
